cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.5)

include($ENV{IDF_PATH}/tools/cmake/project.cmake)

set(EXTRA_COMPONENT_DIRS
    ./components/bsp_extra
    ./components/TinyGPSPlus-ESPIDF
    )

add_compile_options(-Wno-format)

# main/lv_conf.h needs to be visible to the lvgl__lvgl component's own
# source files, not just main's - but ESP-IDF component include visibility
# isn't global (a component only sees its own REQUIRES'd components'
# public include dirs), and lvgl__lvgl (managed, gitignored, regenerated by
# the component manager) doesn't - and shouldn't - list main as a
# requirement. Adding main/ to every component's compiler include path
# project-wide is the standard, durable fix (doesn't touch managed_components,
# survives a fresh `idf.py build` after deleting it).
idf_build_set_property(COMPILE_OPTIONS "-I${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/main" APPEND)

project(center-cluster-esp32-p4)
